game.title: Marvel's Spider-Man: Miles Morales
game.blurb: Open-world superhero action-adventure set in Marvel's New York, from Insomniac Games, released 2020-11-12. RAWG average playtime: 9 hours. Genre: Action. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Miles Morales steps up as a new Spider-Man to protect his new home. Spoiler-guarded.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 1817190)
StrategyWiki: stub page only, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Marvel's_Spider-Man:_Miles_Morales
Fandom (marvels-spider-man.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://marvels-spider-man.fandom.com/wiki/Marvel's_Spider-Man:_Miles_Morales
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0); Walkthrough, Gameplay and Trophies are linked but not written, and only Controls and Table of Contents subpages exist. marvels-spider-man.fandom.com answers the API, with about 41 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Pop Tart" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 1817190. 21 of 50 Steam achievements are hidden and all sit in the main story chapter; the ones listed between "Launch, Swing and Dive" and "Spider-Training: Complete" look like training challenges, and "Under Their Noses", "Underground Undone", "Come at the King", "Deep Cuts" and "Competitive Spirit" are probably side content, so these need checking. "Like a Rhino in a China Shop" (steering Rhino through the mall) was put in the main story; "Never Saw It Coming" (Enemy Base) in open world.
